text:
Elena: Quick Q from today's all-hands infra segment re: GPU supply + autoscaling. Leaving the thread for follow-ups.
Elena: Main asks: per-region H100 ETA, fallback order when H100s run out, and autoscaler tuning for 10-60s spikes.
Tom: Short answers: ETA is staged by supply - us-east pilot late June, eu-west pilot early July, apac experimental late Aug. Will confirm exact dates after vendor pool allocation.
Wei: For Hosted customers, will H100 be transparent or opt-in? Migration risk?
Tom: We'll route latency-sensitive routes to H100 when available; customers can opt-out in Console. No forced migration of pinned models.
Rohit: We saw cold-starts on 20s spikes last week. Any runtime mitigation?
Tom: Adding a transient warm pool and a "quick-reserve" init path to keep minimal artifacts alive for ~40s. Expect config in next deploy.
Elena: Fallback chain? cost-first or latency-first?
Tom: Default: tenant preference -> latency-priority -> cost-aware. Chain: H100 -> A100-80 -> A100-40 -> CPU fallback. We will expose preference profiles in Console.
sre-bot: Incident note uploaded: spike-2026-06-11 (link internal).
Wei: Can Ops get a Console indicator for regional capacity (green/yellow/red)?
console-bot: Console roadmap item created: region-capacity-badges, target: end of Q2 (beta).
Elena: Action items: Tom to publish per-region ETA, Tom to post autoscaler knobs, Billing to share burst pricing draft, Console to provide badge mock. I'll follow up in #eng-infra.
Tom: Got it, will post the autoscaler snippet and `kubectl` debug commands in #eng-infra by EOD.
Elena: Thanks all :raised_hands:
